title: Evidence for a differential innervation of the spinal motor columns by substance P and serotonin in the fetal monkey.
abstract: In the late-term fetal monkey, serotonin (5HT) and substance P (SP) immunoreactivities were localized to two distinct neural networks in the ventral horn of the spinal cord. In contrast, the adult monkey has SP and 5HT colocalized to the same terminals.
